description: Sandbox error contracts observed against Railway on 2026-09-16 using a valid environment and nonexistent source/checkpoint IDs. All failures returned HTTP 200 with INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR and the named mutation path. Missing sandbox query/destroy/heartbeat returned null; missing checkpoint deletion returned false, not errors. No probes created resources.

value.description: The sandbox to execute in, checkpoint, or fork does not exist. Observed exact message: Sandbox not found.
The named checkpoint to rename or boot does not exist. Both exact messages were observed live.

matchers.message: Sandbox checkpoint not found. Build or capture it before creating a sandbox from it.

value.description: Invalid sandbox creation options. Live CPU and memory errors ended in 'at most 24 vCPU' and 'at most 24 GB'; the idle timeout range was 1 to 120 minutes. Match stable prefixes for workspace-dependent limits. The source-conflict message mentions checkpointName, but introspection exposes checkpoint restore only through template.name.

Provide either template.name or template.instructions, not both
